subject: Azure Marketplace CAIQ: owner attestation & log extraction request
messages:
From: Regina Holt <regina.holt@acmeclouds.com>
To: Azure Marketplace Team <azure-marketplace@microsoft.com>
Cc: soojin.lee@redwood.com, priya.natarajan@redwood.com
Date: Thu, 15 Apr 2027 16:04:00 -0700
Subject: Request: CAIQ owner attestation + recent logs for listing intake

Hi team,

We are progressing Redwood Inference through the Azure Marketplace security intake. The marketplace intake requires:
- Completed CAIQ control mapping with owner attestation for controls that affect data isolation and key management (we flagged ~18 controls).
- Recent runtime logs (sample last 14 days) for network egress & access events for the tenant used in the listing demo (timestamped).

Can Redwood provide:
1) a CAIQ mapping file (spreadsheet or JSON) that includes the control id, your mapping, owner name, and an attestation column with a date/signature;
2) a tarball of relevant logs or an extraction procedure we can validate;
3) an expected delivery date and point of contact for any clarifying questions.

Attaching the marketplace intake checklist for reference."Attachments: Marketplace_CAIQ_Intake_Checklist.pdf (application/pdf)"

Thanks,
Regina
Senior Partner Ops
Acme Clouds

From: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.com>
To: Regina Holt <regina.holt@acmeclouds.com>
Cc: priya.natarajan@redwood.com, karthik.iyer@redwood.com, Azure Marketplace Team <azure-marketplace@microsoft.com>
Date: Fri, 16 Apr 2027 09:28:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: CAIQ owner attestation + recent logs for listing intake

Hi Regina —

Thanks for the heads-up and checklist. We can support this.

Plan / owners:
- Priya Natarajan (security operations) will produce the CAIQ control mapping with owner assignments and attestations.
- Karthik Iyer (platform engineering) will extract the runtime logs and provide a filtered tarball plus an extraction README.

Timeline:
- Initial mapping + attestation draft: 2027-04-17 EOD PT.
- Log sample & extraction instructions: 2027-04-18 EOD PT.

Action items for Acme / Azure intake team: please confirm the exact tenant/tenant-id you want logs from (we have demo and staging tenants available). Also let us know if you prefer DocuSign for attestation, or a signed spreadsheet cell is acceptable.

I'll loop Priya and Karthik into this thread — thanks both.

Best,
Soojin Lee
Head of Security Compliance
Redwood Inference

Soojin / Regina —

Attached is a first pass: CAIQ_Control_Map_v1.xlsx. It includes: control id, our mapped control (Redwood control name), control owner (team + owner email), current evidence artifact name, and an "attested_on" column that we've left blank for signature/date.

Notes / open items:
- CSA-CLOUD-EC-02 (network segmentation) — our mapping references the VPC/segmentation document in  /docs/networking/vpc-segmentation.md and tenant-level NSG rules. Karthik, can you confirm we can extract a filtered network flow log for the Acme demo tenant for the last 14 days?
- System log volumes are heavy; we can provide a 14-day filtered subset (access events, admin ops, egress > external). Sample naming: syslog_sample_20270401-0415.tar.gz

Regina: I've included a suggested attestation language in the spreadsheet so you can perform a quick sign-off. If DocuSign is required, happy to generate a request once you confirm.

Attachments: CAIQ_Control_Map_v1.xlsx (application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.spreadsheetml.sheet)
